name: The Common Table Harvest
prompt: Grow a continuous rectangular hedge around a long clear tabletop. Fruit hangs inward at arm's reach. Neighbours dine through gaps pruned into the hedge, replacing every fruit they pick with a bright ribbon marking the next gardener's work.

name: The Shade Cooperative
prompt: Train flat-topped trees in movable soil boxes on a diamond grid of tracks. Neighbours pull them into a shared grove over the hottest courtyard. A small crew plants low flowers in the sunlit outlines left behind.

name: The Garden of Spare Keys
prompt: Make a series of adjoining pocket gardens enclosed by low ochre walls. Oversized wooden gate leaves hinge sideways into benches linking the gardens. Families slide a common supper along the continuous bench while children run through the newly opened gaps.

name: The Unpaid Hour
prompt: Set a broken stone clock face flat amid an orchard. Each missing wedge becomes an allotment devoted to a different leisure activity. Someone has planted strawberries along the discarded iron minute hand, now resting across two wedges.

name: A Roof for Every Seed
prompt: Raise a patchwork of paper-thin terracotta roofs on slender poles at waist height. Each roof directs rain into a neighbouring seedbed, forming a loose herringbone pattern. Gardeners exchange roofs on a handcart as thirsty seedlings outgrow their patch.
